regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: DOS EXE header: 1,322 relocations, initial stack at 1201:0080. Rebuilt by the museum unpacker after removing DIET.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: 1,322 far addresses that DOS adjusts for the load segment, 4 bytes each.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Zero bytes that round the header up to 333 paragraphs.

regions.label: Borland C++ start-up (c0)
regions.note: Sets up segments and the stack, clears the zero-filled data, calls main.

regions.label: Borland C++ runtime library
regions.note: C and C++ library code: operator new and delete, file I/O, memset, movmem and more.

regions.label: TextEditor class (segment 02D1)
regions.note: The only new segment: 22 functions, 6,688 bytes, none of them in Digi-Test. Lines, typing, cursor moves, load and save.

regions.label: Key loop and window helpers (0473)
regions.note: The key loop at 0473:01A9 is new; 3 of the 5 compared functions match Digi-Test.

regions.label: Digi-Test code (04BB)
regions.note: 7 of 8 compared functions match Digi-Test instruction for instruction.

regions.label: main, menus and dialogs (0541)
regions.note: main at 0541:0003 is new; 40 of the other 42 compared functions match Digi-Test (14,384 of 15,709 bytes).

regions.label: New helper (0917)
regions.note: One function, 303 bytes, not in Digi-Test.

regions.label: Digi-Test code (092A)
regions.note: 9 of 10 compared functions match Digi-Test, including one of 2,138 instructions.

regions.label: Keyboard helpers (0B23)
regions.note: 3 small functions, all from Digi-Test; 0B23:000C reads a key.

regions.label: Window classes (0B2D)
regions.note: The Digi-Test window base class and drawing helpers: 27 of 32 compared functions match.

regions.label: BGI graphics library
regions.note: Borland Graphics Interface, byte for byte the same as in EDITOR.EXE apart from one data segment value (15,472 bytes).

regions.label: Runtime data
regions.note: Borland copyright string and runtime error messages.

regions.label: His strings and method tables
regions.note: NONAME.TXT, the TextEditor method table at 00ADh, menus and help lines, many shared with Digi-Test.

regions.label: Runtime and BGI data
regions.note: Graphics card names, BGI error messages and runtime tables.

regions.label: Zero-filled data
regions.note: Cleared at start-up (1042h to 10E6h). 1042h holds the application object that main runs.

routines.name: TextEditor::TextEditor
routines.note: Constructor: allocates the 80-byte object if needed, calls the Digi-Test window constructor, sets the method table, makes the 500-slot line table and line 0.

lines.note: operator new(50h) when this is null

routines.name: TextEditor::handle_key
routines.note: Method table slot 2: F10 opens the menu, other keys go to about a dozen editing methods.

routines.name: TextEditor::insert
routines.note: Tab becomes 8 spaces; pads past the end of the text; movmem opens a gap of 255 - column bytes.

routines.name: key_loop
routines.note: Starts as if F10 was pressed, reads keys, ends on Alt-X, and calls method slot 2 of the active window.

lines.note: Pretend F10: the FILE menu opens at start

routines.name: main
routines.note: Creates the application object, runs the key loop, destroys it with flag 3, closes graphics.
